glossary.力量: 每层力量通常使攻击额外造成 1 点伤害。
glossary.敏捷: 每层敏捷通常使获得的格挡额外增加 1。
glossary.虚弱: 虚弱单位造成的攻击伤害会降低。
glossary.格挡: 格挡会优先抵消即将受到的伤害。
glossary.消耗: 消耗牌打出后会移出本场战斗。
glossary.中毒: 中毒会在该角色回合开始时造成等量伤害（无视格挡），然后层数减少。

plan4.plays: 狂乱逃离, then 咕嘟冒泡 -> 无厌沙虫
plan4.enemies_after: 无厌沙虫 206 HP, 中毒 20
plan4.rollout: 5-turn rollout (24 samples): expected further HP loss 24.9, fight over within 5 turns in 1/24, expected turns to the end (surviving samples) ~5, dead within 5 turns in 23/24 (~turn 2.6); ranked on -(further loss) - 40 x (1 - win chance): win chance ~4% (fights won in the samples, the others by the end-of-horizon estimate), value -63.2
plan4.history_estimate: further HP loss 25, win 4% (this encounter n=2; estimate from boss fights n=260, typical error ±9.9; few similar states for this encounter)
plan4.whole_fight_sim: low confidence: win 0% (vs the simulation's best line −2 ± 1 pts), HP lost when won median 21, ~5 turns to win (this one included); the losing samples die most often on T7 (dead in 100%); 1200 samples
